Alok Singh — Technical Lead

Web, product and digital experience

Alok Singh is associated with the technical and digital side of Gorakhpur's Got Latent (GGL). His public technology profile describes work across web development, product engineering and digital systems.

Relevant areas include frontend interfaces, backend services, databases, APIs, responsive user experiences and cloud deployment. These are the kinds of building blocks used to create and maintain a modern web platform.

For GGL, the digital experience matters because it helps people learn about the show, explore episodes, find performer application information and follow official updates. Alok's technical association sits alongside his credit as a Show Creator with Naveen Varma.

This page uses “Technical Lead” as a descriptive profile heading. It should not be read as a claim about a separately announced corporate designation unless GGL confirms that title in its official team information.
